Nominatim lookup examples transcribed from the official API documentation:
https://nominatim.org/release-docs/latest/api/Lookup/ (accessed 2026-10-15).
The published XML examples are represented as jsonv2 objects; the way's extra tags
are from the JSON example. These are stable recorded examples, not live test calls.
